description_en: Supports real-time addition or update of data in a specific dataset. The system matches records based on the primary key value of the target dataset and the primary key value of the new data record (such as "pk_id" = "2026aa01"). If the primary key value matches, the data record is updated. If no match exists, the data record is added
description_zh: 支持实时向特定数据集中新增或更新数据。系统会依据目标数据集主键值、和新数据记录主键值（如 “pk_id” = “2026aa01”）匹配：若主键值匹配成功，则更新该条数据记录；若匹配不存在，则新增该条数据记录
name: ImportDatasetData

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. You can view this in the dataset list in the console
parameters.help_zh: 数据集 ID，可在控制台数据集列表中查看
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of data records to add or update. A maximum of 100 records can be included in a single batch operation.

Note: The records must strictly follow the schema configured for the target dataset in the console. The specific add/update logic depends on the primary key type of the target dataset. For detailed example requests, see the "Request description" section below
parameters.help_zh:
新增或更新的数据列表。一次批量操作最多不超过 100 条。

说明： 传入的 records 必须完全参照目标数据集在控制台配置的 Schema。具体的 新增/更新 逻辑取决于目标数据集的主键类型。详细示例请求见下方「请求说明」
parameters.name: records

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates a successful request. Other values indicate exceptions. For more information, see error codes
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。200 表示请求成功，其他值表示异常，详见错误码

data.description_en: The returned data body, using an empty placeholder
data.description_zh: 返回的数据主体，使用空占位符

requestId.description_en: The unique request ID, used for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求唯一标识，用于问题排查
